NUC.text: Curriculum adheres to Core Curriculum and Minimum Academic Standards (CCMAS)?
Academic Staff to Student ratio does not exceed 1:30?
Minimum of 70% of academic staff possess a Ph.D.?
Adequate physical facilities (lecture theaters, equipped laboratories) exist for cohort size?
University library contains contemporary physical and e-resources for the specific discipline?
Evidence of consistent external moderation of examinations?

NBTE.text: Curriculum reflects a 70:30 ratio of Practical/Hands-on to Theoretical instruction?
Workshops and studios have modern, industry-standard equipment?
Students actively participate in the Supervised Industrial Work Experience Scheme (SIWES)?
Adequate consumable materials are provided for practical examinations?
Health and Safety protocols are strictly enforced in all workshop areas?

INTERNAL.text: Departmental committee records and minutes are up to date?
Student feedback forms have been administered and analyzed for the current semester?
Faculty attendance and lecture punctuality meet university guidelines?
Course outlines were distributed to students within the first two weeks of resumption?
